basis: All four HQ blockers were reproduced against this branch's owner before repair; all four reproduced exactly.
The prior claim 'retained state is always owner-derived' was false at the minting layer: the token guarded the leaf but not the projection that mints it.
OwnerStateProjection, RouteObligation and RecursiveCoverageCustody are all factory-only and fail closed on direct construction.
The derive/derive_fn injection point is deleted outright, so no caller can supply arbitrary projection logic.

Refusals use exact type identity. Pre553AuthorityError subclasses Pre553IntegrityError, so an isinstance check would have collapsed two mandatory states; the integrity factory refuses it outright and a court asserts the relation.
A learned route now requires an owner-derived obligation; a competent direct route still does not.
Custody no longer carries a completeness_state, because RecursiveBranchHandoff does not own a completeness grade.
Positive recursive handoff state comes from OwnerStateProjection.from_recursive_handoff with required custody.
The fixture no longer reconstructs a projection to substitute supporting_refs; the adaptive factory carries the owner's own refs.
The learned-label acceptance court was replaced by a refusal hostile, as HQ required.
The prior 175 remains valid and passing; 11 hostiles added for 185 passed, 0 failed.
